dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, light-gray perimeters forming both closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' structures against a dark background. The edges show a sharp, mottled gradient transition from the dark exterior pelage to a high-contrast light-gray perimeter, which then encloses a dark interior core of similar intensity to the exterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-gray pixel clusters distributed mainly in the posterior-dorsal region and within the interstitial regions between larger annuli. These blobs lack internal contrast gradients and appear as singular high-intensity points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli located in the upper-left, center-left, and center-top sections of the frame. A secondary linear alignment of three smaller high-intensity blobs is visible in the lower-left quadrant, oriented approximately 45 degrees to the horizontal axis.
